fields.objection: A positive sufficient local acoustic bound verifies the selected regularized StVK law at saved passing states only. It does not establish global or nonaxisymmetric stability, and changing an unsourced regularization does not repair the missing material characterization.
fields.proposed_fix: Use measured in-plane stiffness and a well-posed finite-strain cellular constitutive law, then test geometric and material instabilities with a converged 3D model.
fields.disposition: Inherited-law acceptance withdrawn; regularized result is a projection
